card.name: Small words just before a quantity
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'is', 'of', 'for' or 'to' right before a number and unit are expected. Seen after 'recommended dosage', 'stable', 'overdoses up' and 'rate of'.

modes.label: Dosage statement
modes.description: The word 'is' or 'of' after 'dose' or 'dosage', just before the amount.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dosage of AMVUTTRA<< is>> 25 mg administered by subcut

modes.label: Duration or limit
modes.description: 'for' or 'to' just before a length of time or an upper amount.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE Single oral overdoses up<< to>> 2.8 g were not associated
